oai_dc:dc.dc:title: Green space access and summer greenness, Devon, 2024
oai_dc:dc.dc:creator: Peter S (portfolio project)
oai_dc:dc.dc:subject: green space; urban greenness; NDVI; accessibility; environmental indicators; Sentinel-2; Devon
oai_dc:dc.dc:description: Indicators for the ten local authorities of Devon and their 2021 Lower layer Super Output Areas (LSOAs). GSA_300M is the share of residents who live within 300 m (straight line) of a public green space of at least 0.5 ha, the WHO Europe benchmark, from census population modelled per address and OS Open Zoomstack green space. NDVI_MEAN and NDVI_VEG_PCT describe summer 2024 greenness from cloud-masked Sentinel-2 imagery: the mean normalised difference vegetation index and the share of the area with NDVI above 0.5. NDVI_CLEAR_PCT gives the share of each area with a cloud-free observation, as a quality measure for the two NDVI indicators.
